Create SEVEN separate circular game icons on ONE transparent PNG sprite sheet, landscape 2048x1024, four icons in the top row and three in the bottom row (bottom row aligned with first three columns). Every disc identical size, perfectly circular, separated by ample transparent gaps; nothing touches or overlaps. Image 1 is ONLY the DISC BACKGROUND reference: faithfully reproduce its very dark almost black night-violet cosmic surface with bright saturated electric PURPLE / indigo NEBULA STREAKS sweeping roughly HORIZONTALLY across the disc, broken wispy bands and a few tiny violet stars. Keep this original dark, high-contrast streaky nebula character rather than replacing it with an evenly lit cloudy purple texture. Ignore the black hammer, red arrow, labels, grey background and screenshot border in image1. Image2 is ONLY the exact seven SYMBOL SHAPES and their size/pose reference. Preserve those silhouettes and proportions: top row from left to right (1) upright fire extinguisher with curved hose and nozzle projecting to upper-right, (2) diagonal claw hammer head at upper-left and handle at lower-right, (3) thick upright upward arrow with wide triangular head and short square shaft, (4) double-ended open wrench diagonal lower-left to upper-right. Bottom row from left to right (5) three horizontally stacked ammunition rounds between two large rounded arrows curling around them in a cycle, (6) upright tall bullet cartridge with a small stopwatch cutout on its lower body, (7) lidded trash bin with three vertical slot cutouts. Do not introduce any other symbols or text. Each symbol is large (about60% disc diameter), simple flat MILKY WHITE / very pale lavender at about60% opacity, nebula faintly visible through it, same as image2. The glyphs must remain LIGHT and readable, NOT the black hammer from image1. Thin charcoal-black perimeter ring only; no thick shiny metal border. Crisp clean 2D shapes, front view. Actual alpha transparency outside the seven discs; no checkerboard, no shadows or halos outside the discs. Do NOT reproduce Discord, a screenshot, any application chrome, UI panels, arrows, labels, captions, desktop dock, scenery or backdrop. Seven icons only, ready for later cropping.
